text: Anyone have a good lunch spot rec near the office? I’m tired of the same old sandwiches.
Try Tikka Town on 17th! Their butter chicken is 🔥. Also, has anyone seen the warehouse cat today? She was sleeping on the packing peanuts again yesterday 😂
Omg, I saw her this morning! She was chasing a rogue label across the floor. Also, +1 for Tikka Town. If you want something lighter, Green Seed has good salads.
Did anyone catch the Nuggets game last night? That 3-pointer in the last minute was wild. Also, the cat’s name is officially ‘Boxy’ now, per warehouse consensus.
Boxy is the hero we deserve 😂 Thanks for the lunch tips, y’all! Might try Green Seed today. And yes, Nuggets FTW!
